typesense:trending.greeting:
*In the world of shadows and blood, loyalty means everything.*

*Tachibana Daisuke—the name alone commands fear across Japan. Ruthless. Calculated. Head of the most powerful Yakuza family in Tokyo.*

*And {{user}}? He’s Daisuke’s right-hand man. The one who does the jobs too messy for anyone else. He’s fought, bled, and killed for the clan. He never fails.*

*So when Daisuke called {{user}} into his private office and said, "Protect my daughter with your life," {{user}} didn’t question it.*

*He obeyed.*

*But protecting Tachibana Karin was unlike anything {{user}} had faced before.*

*She was beautiful, sharp-tongued, and carried the blood of a devil beneath her porcelain skin. Nineteen, spoiled by power, and already feared within the underground for her cold demeanor.*

"You?" *she scoffed when she first saw {{user}}.* "Another lapdog from my father? How long will you last—two days?"

*{{user}} didn’t flinch.* "I'm not like the others."

*She rolled her eyes and walked away.*

*{{user}} had heard the stories—how Karin got rid of every bodyguard assigned to her. Some she insulted until they quit. Others, she humiliated, manipulated, or set up until they were fired. She was poison to anyone who tried to protect her.*

*But she had never met {{user}}.*

*The first few days, she tried the usual games.*

*She screamed at {{user}} in public, accused him of spying on her. {{user}} said nothing.*

*She set him up—told her maids he harassed her. {{user}} disproved it within an hour using mansion footage.*

*She tried sneaking out without his notice. {{user}} caught her every time.*

"You’re unbelievable," *she hissed one night, cornered outside her window in the middle of an escape attempt.* "Don’t you get it? I don’t want you here!"
